result.topic_en: Euler explains that the variation expressed through partial-type formulas in t could only be evaluated if t were introduced in a definite way, whereas in true maximum/minimum problems the relation between x and y is unknown, so these formulas have no definite values; he announces a special artifice to reduce them to the form of the first integral formula.
result.transcription:
VARIATIONVM TRACTANDI. 41
quam etiam ſequenti modo per partes repraeſentaſſe iuuabit
$dt\int N\,dx\left(\frac{dy}{dt}\right)+dt\int P\,dx\left(\frac{ddy}{dx\,dt}\right)+dt\int Q\,dx\left(\frac{d^3y}{dx^2.\,dt}\right)+dt\int R\,dx\left(\frac{d^4y}{dx^3\,dt}\right)$ etc.
qua expreſſione contenti eſſe poſſemus, ſi quaeſtio circa caſum aliquem determinatum inſtitueretur, vbi $y$ non ſolum functioni cuipiam datae ipſius $x$ aequaretur, ſed etiam noua variabilis $t$ modo determinato introduceretur; tum enim omnes iſtas formulas $\left(\frac{dy}{dt}\right)$; $\left(\frac{ddy}{dx\,dt}\right)$; $\left(\frac{d^3y}{dx^2\,dt}\right)$ etc. actu euoluere liceret, ita vt tum elementum $dx$ per ſolam functionem ipſius $x$ afficeretur, ſiquidem vti initio innuimus euolutione facta, iterum poni debet $t=0$.

12. At vero tales quaeſtiones determinatae nunquam occurrere ſolent; ſed potius relatio inter $y$ et $x$ ſemper incognita eſſe ſolet, inde demum determinanda, quod variatio in nihilum abire debeat, quippe in quo Methodus maximorum et minimorum verſatur. Huiusmodi quaeſtiones ergo ita enunciari conuenit, qualis relatio inter quantitates $x$ et $y$ intercedere debeat, vt formulae integralis propoſitae $\int Z\,dx$ variatio in nihilum abeat, quomodocunque etiam noua variabilis $t$ in calculum introducatur? Quodſi autem quaeſtio hac ratione inſtituatur, perſpicuum eſt formulis $\left(\frac{dy}{dt}\right)$; $\left(\frac{ddy}{dx\,dt}\right)$; $\left(\frac{d^3y}{dx^2\,dt}\right)$ etc. nullos certos valores tribui poſſe.

13. Verum hic prorſus ſingulare artificium in ſubſidium vocari poteſt, cuius ope formulas integrales poſteriores in § 11 ad formam prioris reduce-
Tom. XVI. Nou. Comm. F

items.quote: qualis relatio inter quantitates $x$ et $y$ intercedere debeat, vt formulae integralis propoſitae $\int Z\,dx$ variatio in nihilum abeat, quomodocunque etiam noua variabilis $t$ in calculum introducatur?
items.english: What relation must hold between the quantities x and y so that the variation of the proposed integral formula ∫Z dx vanishes, in whatever way the new variable t is introduced into the calculation?

items.quote: perſpicuum eſt formulis $\left(\frac{dy}{dt}\right)$; $\left(\frac{ddy}{dx\,dt}\right)$; $\left(\frac{d^3y}{dx^2\,dt}\right)$ etc. nullos certos valores tribui poſſe.
items.english: It is evident that no definite values can be assigned to the formulas (dy/dt), (ddy/dx dt), (d^3y/dx^2 dt), etc.

items.quote: Verum hic prorſus ſingulare artificium in ſubſidium vocari poteſt, cuius ope formulas integrales poſteriores in § 11 ad formam prioris reduce-
items.english: But here a quite singular artifice can be called to aid, by means of which the latter integral formulas in §11 can be reduced to the form of the first.
